title: The Systems Are Advancing. The Protection Gap Is Wider.
method: AI-assisted cross-source synthesis with direct links to originating publishers. Reviewed against a five-item gate including three primary institutional sources.

items.headline: AU ministers call for financing that turns digital strategies into infrastructure
items.whyItMatters: The record shifts the continental digital agenda from strategy-writing toward financing and delivery. No funding facility, capital amount or implementation timetable was announced, so execution remains the unresolved test.

items.headline: EAC adopts regional AI, digital-transformation and biotechnology strategies
items.whyItMatters: Common strategies and credentials can reduce fragmentation across universities, labour markets and technology policy. Adoption is not rollout: national alignment, financing and measurable implementation remain outstanding.

items.headline: Moyale displacement estimate rises to as many as 50,000 people
items.whyItMatters: The displacement is now large enough to strain food, water, shelter and health capacity in northern Kenya while interrupting a regional trade corridor. The population estimate is provisional and responsibility for individual incidents remains unresolved.

items.headline: Drone strikes kill at least 15 people at an Ethiopian displacement camp
items.whyItMatters: A camp holding people displaced by earlier violence became a target itself, deepening the civilian-protection failure in northern Ethiopia. The casualty account is source-based and neither attribution nor legal responsibility has been established.

items.headline: UNTMIS completes its mandate as functions transfer to Somali institutions
items.whyItMatters: The closure ends more than three decades of successive U.N. political missions in Somalia and places greater weight on national institutions during a difficult security transition. Formal transfer does not itself demonstrate that every receiving institution has equivalent capacity.
